_note: PheTwin India educational simulation. Values are illustrative and are not clinically validated. This model is not intended for diagnosis or dietary treatment decisions.

body_weight_kg.citation: Illustrative adult demo scenario. Can be changed for other simulation scenarios.

vd_l_per_kg.citation: Illustrative assumption. A published mechanistic PKU model used 0.5 L/kg. Distribution volume depends on the compartmental model and is not a universal physiological constant.

km_mg_per_l.citation: Illustrative model assumption. Published recombinant human PAH studies report different apparent Km values depending on experimental conditions and BH4 availability. See PMID: 8806757 and PMC: PMC15912. Not a clinically validated whole-body parameter.

fasting_c0_mg_per_l.citation: Illustrative adult reference-state assumption, approximately 60.5 umol/L. Within the adult plasma Phe reference interval reported by Mayo Clinic Laboratories. Not a universal fasting value.

endogenous_input_mg_per_h.citation: Illustrative constant model input. Human tracer studies report endogenous phenylalanine rate of appearance as an index of whole-body protein breakdown; these measurements are not directly equivalent to this model's net input parameter. See PMID: 9022533.

k_alt_l_per_h.citation: Illustrative mathematical assumption representing additional linear Phe clearance outside the PAH-mediated pathway. Not established as a validated human clearance constant. Subject to sensitivity analysis.

ka_per_h.citation: Illustrative first-order gut absorption rate constant used in the simplified simulation. Not a measured universal human phenylalanine absorption rate. Subject to sensitivity analysis.

bioavailability.citation: Illustrative fixed bioavailability assumption for dietary Phe in the simplified gut absorption model. Not established as a universal absorption fraction across foods. Subject to sensitivity analysis.

phe_mg_per_g_protein.citation: Illustrative fallback assumption only. Food-specific estimates should use documented food composition data wherever available.

target_low_umol_l.context: Illustrative lower target only. Clinical applicability depends on age, pregnancy status and the selected guideline.
target_low_umol_l.citation: TO_FILL: verify against a selected PKU clinical guideline and specify the applicable population before clinical interpretation.

target_high_umol_l.context: Illustrative upper target only. Clinical applicability depends on age, pregnancy status and the selected guideline.
target_high_umol_l.citation: TO_FILL: verify against a selected PKU clinical guideline and specify the applicable population before clinical interpretation.
